entry_rule: rows with q_fdr_bh_global_family < 0.05 in the matching scale-specific atlas; every atlas row remains reported regardless of entry

method.entry_rule: rows with q_fdr_bh_global_family < 0.05 in the matching scale-specific atlas; every atlas row remains reported regardless of entry
method.dominant_taxa_rule: rank taxa only by full environment-cohort observation count with alphabetical tie-breaking; omit each top-10 taxon separately and the top two jointly
method.equal_taxon_weight_rule: within-taxon rows only; assign each observation weight 1/n for its taxon so every retained taxon has equal total weight
method.region_rule: omit each mapped Natural Earth broad region separately; recompute trait and environment summaries after omission
method.native_rule: retain only observations explicitly classified native by the frozen WCVP/TDWG lookup; unresolved, introduced, unlisted and unmapped rows are excluded fail-closed
method.linear_stability_rule: preserve the sign of the atlas coefficient
method.circular_stability_rule: positive cosine alignment with the atlas sine-cosine coefficient vector, equivalent to an angular difference below 90 degrees
method.inference_rule: descriptive directional and effect-magnitude stability only; do not produce post-selection p-values or a new multiplicity family
method.role: sampling-composition sensitivity, not a correction to a probability sample and not a candidate-promotion gate
claim_boundary: This sensitivity was specified after the full-27 atlas results were inspected.
Directional stability does not make the public-image sample globally representative.
A stable selected row is not a new confirmatory discovery and is not evidence of causation, plasticity or adaptation.
An unevaluable scenario remains unevaluable and is never treated as a stable pass.
